hash_contract.scope: Hash the exact descriptor size bytes at container_offset + image.offset, including image padding present in the container.

readiness_policy.READY_FOR_EXECUTION: Every parsed container is structurally and hash valid and every explicitly required pinned stage is present.
readiness_policy.NOT_ASSERTED: The file is structurally valid but no execution-stage requirement was requested.
readiness_policy.FAIL: No valid container is found or any structure, range, hash or required-stage gate fails.

qualification_boundary: Signature-block fields are parsed but cryptographic signatures are not authenticated.
The parser does not execute or emulate Boot ROM, ELE, OEI, DDR training, ATF or U-Boot.
Synthetic unit-test containers prove parser behavior only and are never accepted as production boot evidence.
Production execution readiness requires exact artifact hashes and real signed production containers supplied through the boot manifest.
